explainer.title: Your STREET DEX: collect the cars you see in real life
explainer.stepsLabel: How a car gets into your Dex

steps.scan: Scan the sticker on a car (that’s a spot)
steps.collect: The car lands in your Dex as a card
steps.sets: Complete sets and find rare cars

counts.title: What counts
counts.body: A spot counts when you scan the Speedclub sticker on a car with the app. Scanning with the camera or in a browser only opens the build page. You can spot the same car once a day.

delay.title: Nothing happens live
delay.body: Your spot lands in your Dex at once. The owner sees it 3 hours later at the earliest, grouped and never with your position.

samples.title: Sample cars never count
samples.body: Cars marked “Sample” only show what the Dex looks like. Scanning them counts neither for your Dex nor for sets.

privacy.title: Only the city
privacy.body: The app uses your location only while scanning and only if you agree. Your phone turns it into a city: only the city is stored, never your position. Spots between 10 pm and 6 am show no city.

sets.title: Sets and rarity
sets.body: Sets group cars together, such as JDM legends, a make or a city. We work out how rare a car is every night, by fixed rules, from the data on Speedclub.
